title: Characterization of TNG348: A Selective, Allosteric USP1 Inhibitor That Synergizes with PARP Inhibitors in Tumors with Homologous Recombination Deficiency
model: BRCA1-mutant UWB1.289 and MDA-MB-436 (DDR library); COV362 and HCC1395 (genome-wide)
contrast: TNG348 vs DMSO, UWB1.289 (1 vs 1); also MDA-MB-436 (1 vs 2), olaparib vs DMSO, and genome-wide paired by line (2 vs 2)
paper_calls: RAD18, UBE2K, UBE2A, RFWD3 resistance; PARP1 sensitizer (90-360 genes per direction at p < 0.05)
named_hits: RAD18 in all three TNG348 analyses; UBE2A/UBE2K in MDA-MB-436; PARP1 genome-wide only; RFWD3 not called
verdict: BARCS recovers RAD18 and the PCNA-ubiquitination genes as TNG348 resistance hits and PARP1 and the BRCA1-A complex as genome-wide sensitizers, but not USP1 or PCNA, and PARP1 passes only in the pooled genome-wide screen. With one library per arm it calls far fewer genes than the paper's p < 0.05 lists.
